mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a criminal offence in academics and is highly penalized."
Plagiarism is a criminal offence in academics and is highly penalized.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the expectation of the human mind while the present is nothing but the present consideration by the human mind."
The future refers to the expectation of the human mind while the present is nothing but the present consideration by the human mind.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the knowledge of the being that comprises of matter, form, God, and will (Popkin 1893, 174-175)."
human existence is the knowledge of the being that comprises of matter, form, God, and will (Popkin 1893, 174-175).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mental phenomenon existing only in the human mind without any objective existence."
Time is a mental phenomenon existing only in the human mind without any objective existence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a three-credit unit course which has minimum duration of one semester."
PHL216 is a three-credit unit course which has minimum duration of one semester.

Augustine is known by several names such as the Angelic Doctor of the Roman Catholic Church, the Christian Neo-platonist and the North African Bishop (Abakedi, 2014).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the source of perfect beauty imperfectly reflected in beautiful things."
God is the source of perfect beauty imperfectly reflected in beautiful things.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the form while the body is matter."
The soul is the form while the body is matter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means employed by the ruler to keep himself in power and to secure the state, is acceptable and justified."
Machiavelli avers that whatever means employed by the ruler to keep himself in power and to secure the state, is acceptable and justified.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known for being persecuted by people whose actions are criticized for being unsavory for the society."
Philosophers are known for being persecuted by people whose actions are criticized for being unsavory for the society.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a necessary fulfilment of the divine creativity, just as the infinite number series is a rationally necessary procession from its source in the number 1."
The universe is a necessary fulfilment of the divine creativity, just as the infinite number series is a rationally necessary procession from its source in the number 1.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for abstract reasoning as in metaphysics while the practical intellect helps in guiding human behavior towards good and away from evil."
The speculative intellect is used for abstract reasoning as in metaphysics while the practical intellect helps in guiding human behavior towards good and away from evil.
